verdict.rationale: Featurebase clearly ships embeddable widgets (changelog, in-app feedback/roadmap widgets) and a JS SDK (featurebase-js) per the docs, indicating some client-side embedding capability, but no evidence describes a literal single <script> tag installation or explicitly states 'no build step' — the SDK is described as a 'typed client SDK', which often implies package-based integration rather than a plain script tag. missing for 10: explicit script-tag snippet, confirmation of zero build tooling requirement, and independent developer confirmation of a copy-paste embed flow.
